exercises.title: Capture Before Moving
exercises.instruction: A capture is available. Take it before making any other move.

feedback.initial: A capture is available. Take it before making any other move.
feedback.selected: Selected. Jump to the highlighted landing square.
feedback.success: If you can capture, you must capture. Ordinary moves are unavailable until no capture exists.
feedback.invalidPiece: A capture is available, so you must use a checker that can capture.
feedback.invalidDestination: That square is not a legal capture destination.

exercises.title: Check the Whole Board
exercises.instruction: One of your checkers must capture. Find it and make the jump.

feedback.initial: One of your checkers must capture. Find it and make the jump.
feedback.selected: Selected. Jump to the highlighted landing square.
feedback.success: Check the entire board before moving. A capture anywhere makes an ordinary move illegal everywhere.
feedback.invalidPiece: A capture is available, so you must use a checker that can capture.
feedback.invalidDestination: That square is not a legal capture destination.

exercises.title: Choose the Capturing Checker
exercises.instruction: Two of your checkers can capture. Choose either one.

feedback.initial: Two of your checkers can capture. Choose either one.
feedback.success: When several checkers can capture, you may choose which checker to use.
feedback.invalidPiece: A capture is available, so you must use a checker that can capture.
feedback.invalidDestination: That square is not a legal capture destination.

exercises.title: Choose the Target
exercises.instruction: Both captures are legal. Choose either one.

feedback.initial: Both captures are legal. Choose either one.
feedback.success: If more than one capture is available, you may choose. You do not have to capture a king instead of a regular checker.
feedback.invalidPiece: A capture is available, so you must use a checker that can capture.
feedback.invalidDestination: That square is not a legal capture destination.

exercises.title: Even When It Costs You
exercises.instruction: This capture is risky, but it is still required. Make the jump.

feedback.initial: This capture is risky, but it is still required. Make the jump.
feedback.selected: Selected. Jump to the highlighted landing square.
feedback.awaitingReply: The capture was required. Watch the reply.
feedback.success: If any capture is available, you must make one. When several captures are legal, the choice is yours.
feedback.invalidPiece: A capture is available, so you must use a checker that can capture.
feedback.invalidDestination: That square is not a legal capture destination.
